question.text: Identify the incorrect statement among the following:

options.text: Viscosity of liquid always decreases with increase in temperature
Surface tension of liquid always decreases with increase in temperature
Viscosity of liquid always increases in presence of impurity
Surface tension of liquid always increases in presence of impurity

solution.text: Hint : Both options C and D are incorrect, as Viscosity and Surface Tension may increase or decrease upon addition of impurities.
